connector.name: MCP Server Couchbase
connector.registryDescription: Couchbase Model Context Protocol Server to interact with Couchbase clusters
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package couchbase-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the couchbase account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CB_CONNECTION_STRING
env.description: Couchbase connection string. Required for connecting to the cluster.

env.name: CB_USERNAME
env.description: Couchbase database username. Required for basic authentication.

env.name: CB_PASSWORD
env.description: Couchbase database password. Required for basic authentication.

env.name: CB_CA_CERT_PATH
env.description: Couchbase CA certificate path. Required for TLS authentication in non Capella clusters.

env.name: CB_CLIENT_CERT_PATH
env.description: Couchbase client certificate path. Required for mTLS authentication.

env.name: CB_CLIENT_KEY_PATH
env.description: Couchbase client key path. Required for mTLS authentication.

env.name: CB_MCP_READ_ONLY_MODE
env.description: Couchbase read only mode. Set to true to allow disable write operations across both KV and query. KV write tools are not loaded and SQL++ queries that modify data are blocked. Set to false to allow data modification queries and tools.

env.name: CB_MCP_TRANSPORT
env.description: Transport mode for the server (stdio, http or sse). Default is stdio

env.name: CB_MCP_HOST
env.description: Host to run the MCP server on (default: 127.0.0.1). Used only for HTTP and SSE transport modes.

env.name: CB_MCP_PORT
env.description: Port to run the MCP server on (default: 8000). Used only for HTTP and SSE transport modes.

env.name: CB_MCP_DISABLED_TOOLS
env.description: Tools to disable. Accepts comma-separated tool names (e.g., 'tool_1,tool_2') or a file path containing one tool name per line.

env.name: CB_MCP_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED_TOOLS
env.description: Comma-separated tool names that require user confirmation before execution. Also accepts a file path containing one tool name per line. Requires the MCP client to support elicitation.
